title: Prove cnf lemmas over a distinct's pairs by propagation
summary: The Lean reconstructor now reads a distinct over terms as its pairs' negated equalities and projects wide conjunctions from checkpoints, so cnf lemmas over a distinct are proved by propagation instead of the grind fallback. Lean's peak memory on QF_UF NEQ004 drops from 7.06 GB to 5.54 GB.
